paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan, the scribe of Gufta, Rav Huna entered his sukkah (Jerusalem Talmud, HaYashen). At the beginning of Bammeh Behemah, Chanan of Gufta said before Shmuel: ‘Rav Chiyya bar Ashi did not practice thus.’ Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah 3:7:2 (cited here as 3:8): Rabbi Yonatan of Gufta saw Bar Avuna the scribe. Tractate Soferim, chapter 12: ‘of Guftera saw Rabbi Avuna.’ See Rabbi Yitzchak bar Gufta.
